from collections import deque

def transform(grid):
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    hr=next(r for r in range(h) if all(v==1 for v in grid[r]))
    vc=next(c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c]==1 for r in range(h)))
    def red_bbox(r0,r1,c0,c1):
        cells=[(r,c) for r in range(r0,r1) for c in range(c0,c1) if grid[r][c]==2]
        rs=[x[0] for x in cells]; cs=[x[1] for x in cells]
        return min(rs),max(rs)+1,min(cs),max(cs)+1
    def components(r0,r1,c0,c1):
        seen=set(); comps=[]
        for r in range(r0,r1):
            for c in range(c0,c1):
                if (r,c) in seen or grid[r][c] in (4,2): continue
                color=grid[r][c]; stack=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c)); cells=[]
                while stack:
                    a,b=stack.pop(); cells.append((a,b))
                    for da,db in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        x,y=a+da,b+db
                        if r0<=x<r1 and c0<=y<c1 and (x,y) not in seen and grid[x][y]==color:
                            seen.add((x,y)); stack.append((x,y))
                comps.append((color,cells))
        return comps
    for r0,r1 in ((0,hr),(hr+1,h)):
        sr0,sr1,sc0,sc1=red_bbox(r0,r1,0,vc)
        tr0,tr1,tc0,tc1=red_bbox(r0,r1,vc+1,w)
        sy=(tr1-tr0)/(sr1-sr0); sx=(tc1-tc0)/(sc1-sc0)
        for color,cells in components(r0,r1,0,vc):
            rs=[p[0] for p in cells]; cs=[p[1] for p in cells]
            a,b=min(rs),max(rs)+1; c,d=min(cs),max(cs)+1
            na=round(tr0+(a-sr0)*sy); nb=round(tr0+(b-sr0)*sy)
            nc=round(tc0+((sc1-sc0)-(d-sc0))*sx)
            nd=round(tc0+((sc1-sc0)-(c-sc0))*sx)
            for rr in range(na,nb):
                for cc in range(nc,nd): out[rr][cc]=color
    return out

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    cells = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == 5]
    points = set(cells)
    length = len(cells)
    col_counts = [sum(grid[r][c] == 0 for r in range(h)) for c in range(w)]
    row_counts = [sum(v == 0 for v in row) for row in grid]
    vertical = [c for c in range(w) if col_counts[c] == max(col_counts)]
    horizontal = [r for r in range(h) if row_counts[r] == max(row_counts)]
    cr = (min(horizontal) + max(horizontal)) // 2
    cc = (min(vertical) + max(vertical)) // 2
    vertical_symmetry = all((r, 2 * cc - c) in points for r, c in cells)
    out = [[7] * w for _ in range(h)]
    if vertical_symmetry:
        start = cc - length // 2
        for c in range(w):
            out[cr - 1][c] = 0
            out[cr + 1][c] = 0
        for r in range(h):
            out[r][cc] = 0
        for c in range(start, start + length):
            out[cr][c] = 5
    else:
        start = cr - length // 2
        for r in range(h):
            out[r][cc - 1] = 0
            out[r][cc + 1] = 0
        for c in range(w):
            out[cr][c] = 0
        for r in range(start, start + length):
            out[r][cc] = 5
    return out
